purpose: Complete XGTC activation CDR/gearbox/PHY initialization and restore MAC-before-laser ordering.
defects: Native activation omitted the original post-burst four-step CDR reset, gearbox pulse and PHY initialization request. Earlier parameter loading is a separate sequence.
Native activation released TX_DISABLE before setting MAC active; original enable releases it after MAC enable and a1ms wait.
fix: Preserve other bits of SerDes0x400 and apply0x80/0xd0/0x70/0 with1ms intervals and10ms settle; pulse gearbox reset1ms/100ms and request PHY initialization.
Restart after burst enable, sample ACTP after restart, enable MAC, wait1ms, then release TX_DISABLE.
Propagate indirect-access failure through activation and SerDes error state; disable burst, retain TX_DISABLE and drop OMCI carrier.
Retain startup with absent light: publish the bounded original RX-init wait as sync_result; carrier remains controlled by line state.

verification.compared: Four stock/native write-and-delay traces: XG-PON/XGS-PON with normal and PRBS fixtures. Native indirect failure and LOS status checked separately.
verification.scope: Actual original MAC enable/reset/burst/gearbox/global setters and native activation/reset. MMIO, indirect completion, delays, GPIO, locks and netdev state are modeled. Compare write ordering and requested waits, not elapsed silicon timing or optical registration.

additional_research.TCONT_initialization: REA __gpon_common_init is GPON-specific; no evidence established that this setup belongs in XGTC T-CONT0.
additional_research.upstream_scheduler: REA aal_puc_port_voq_map_set selects the same ITU branch for modes3..6 and includes the existing queue0/1 weight coupling. No new mode-specific mismatch established.
additional_research.original_watchdog: Additional heuristic full-reset paths in the original state timer were not transplanted.

limits: MMIO, waits and GPIO are modeled; no physical PON/OLT or clock-settling validation.
This does not establish the cause of peer -110 or approximately50-second ACTP reset.
Two targeted scripts and two ARM64 objects with partial link; no full test suite or kernel link.
